Poly Haven, CC0 1.0
https://polyhaven.com/a/painted_wooden_table
https://polyhaven.com/a/painted_wooden_stool
https://polyhaven.com/a/wooden_candlestick
https://polyhaven.com/a/wooden_table_02

The table uses the Archive's existing gouache walnut material. The candlestick
uses the wooden holder from the base mesh together with the Quaternius candle.
The corner tables (wooden_table_02) are stored as geometry only, without the
2k source textures, and painted with the same gouache walnut.
